commands.name: init
commands.summary: Creates the workspace in the current folder, and refuses inside an existing one.

commands.name: new
commands.summary: Adds a product folder from the type's starter skeleton at version 1.0.0.

commands.name: import
commands.summary: Unpacks a product export bundle into its type folder, or refreshes an existing folder.

commands.name: dev
commands.summary: Starts the preview server on the workspace index, with live reload and the problems overlay.

commands.name: check
commands.summary: Runs the platform's rules on the named products, or on every product with --all.

commands.name: status
commands.summary: Shows each product's local and live versions, review state, and what changed since the last push.

commands.name: plan
commands.summary: Lists exactly what to push as data: template, options, listing, assets, and release notes.

commands.name: synced
commands.summary: Records a get_product result read from standard input as the product's last known remote state.

commands.name: release
commands.summary: Closes the Unreleased changelog section after submit_for_review succeeds, and tags the version.

commands.name: version
commands.summary: Sets the next version, and is refused while the current version is in review.
